skills.belief: Establish the HEINONG84 field only after weather, soil, inventory, and tractor checks.
skills.action_pattern: field prep, base fertilizer, 1.1 m ridges, plant in 4-ridge blocks at depth 4.0 cm and seed spacing 7.9 cm

skills.belief: When storage/dryer capacity matters, harvest in batches after checking maturity, moisture, weather, trafficability, and available capacity.
skills.action_pattern: harvest first batch in 4-ridge blocks, unload, dry to safe target if needed, store, recheck capacity
constraints: do not store wet grain directly
do not continue without capacity check

skills.belief: After one batch is stored, the remaining batch needs its own readiness and capacity check.
skills.action_pattern: harvest remaining batch in 4-ridge blocks, unload, dry if needed, store, recheck inventory
constraints: do not assume the remaining batch is safe without recheck
